May 31, 2025 - ScS is a home furnishings retailer in the United Kingdom, specialising in sofas and occasional furniture. ScS was established in Sunderland, Tyne and Wear in 1894, as a family owned home furnishings store. By the 1980s, there were eight ScS stores in the North East of England.
